title: Specialists Emit adrCandidates When a Trigger Fires

acceptanceCriteria.description: Given a step whose work matches an ADR trigger, When the specialist writes its output, Then it includes an adrCandidate with title, context and decision, without being asked in the prompt.
Given the design, implement and boundary-check skills, When each is inspected, Then each documents which triggers apply to it and what to put in a candidate.
Given a specialist that emits a candidate, When it does so, Then it still does not write into .nit/adr/ — promotion stays a human decision behind the approval gate.
